GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   C. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   D. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   C. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   B. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Weather as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

6. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   D. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

8. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   C. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Climate as rumours only.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

11. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   D. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   B. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   D. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   D. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   B. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Transport and Communication and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
